A '''grandmaster''' was an honorific title given to master players of the game [[Dejarik/Legends|dejarik]]. [[Krestin Baas]] was a known dejarik grandmaster, and a holographic version of him was included in [[Lakan Industries/Legends|Lakan Industries']] [[DHS-2]] holographic dejarik system.
